title: Look Again at the Syntax: Relational Graph Convolutional Network for Gendered Ambiguous Pronoun Resolution

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating coreference resolution performance on the gender-balanced Gendered Ambiguous Pronouns (GAP) dataset, specifically measuring the model's ability to resolve ambiguous gendered pronouns (like 'he' and 'she') using F1 score and log-loss metrics.
